extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: ice cream truck, approx. 5.8 x 2.3 x 4.0 m (L x W x H incl. roof cone), box height 2.9 m, wheel diameter 0.8 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; serving window with counter and striped awning on the right side (-X); 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll); opaque tinted windows, no interior; decorative ice cream cone on the roof; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
